description: The single active specification declaration. One instrument under two scoring specifications that differ only in the three components below. Both use the same evidence, reviewed records, combination engine, thresholds, and analysis code. Recorded reviewer values are never overwritten: a component selects or overrides an effective input, and every step is retained in the resolution output.

is_not: an estimate of truth lying between the endpoints

derivation.predicate: both compare_fields are in ordinal_values AND they are unequal
derivation.exclusion_reason: RU is an information status rather than an ordinal score, so a comparison involving it is not a dissent in degree.

override.grounds: Heterogeneous categories can support plausible regular research; this does not assert that every establishment researches.
Distinguishes occupation-specific evidence from family-level inference. This is the only occupation research base that differs between the specifications; no family-wide harmonization is applied.

common_to_both_specifications.note: Operations applied identically under both specifications, before the three differing components resolve. No clinical-axis entry exists: every industry keeps the clinical context recorded in its reviewed decision.

mathematics_faculty_erratum.grounds: Construct consistency motivated the correction. SDR was examined during refinement, so this is criterion-exposed and must be disclosed as such rather than presented as independent prespecification.

withdrawn_teaching_overrides.status: withdrawn as specification-dependent; retained as a common value
withdrawn_teaching_overrides.grounds: No family-wide harmonization. The recorded grounds for each occupation stand, and the criterion use behind the withdrawal is disclosed rather than presented as an independent judgment.
